Dear [Miss Walker](../persons.html#2234)
Thank you for writing to tell me of the fate of the letters, I am afraid such has often befallen the like when they descend to a generation too young to care for them and not wishing for the encumbrance. I have a screen worked in that way by my mother, but I think almost all my other possessions of the kind have worn out.
[Mr Hobart Hampden](../persons.html#703) has his eldest sister [Sarah](../persons.html#702) staying with him, and I hope she will make her home with him, as the father died in the winter and the other two sisters are in India[^1]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: The Rev.

Alfred Bertie Hobart-Hampden (1860-1923), rector of Cottered, Herts.

His eldest sister was Sarah Maria Hobart Hampden (d.1939).

Their mother was Jane Awdry (d.1874).
